summary: The iteration-2 state-field and summary blockers are corrected and all supplied tests pass, but counter/state consistency, empty initialized rank-sparse state, and post-load rollback remain fail-closed blockers.

blockers.finding: Counter and state semantics are not related: replicated_rmsprop_calls can exceed optimizer_calls times the RMSProp-group count, a per-parameter step can exceed optimizer_calls, and nonfinite state tensors pass the pre-load schema gate and reach the raw loader.
blockers.required_correction: Validate counter bounds/divisibility, per-parameter step bounds and finiteness for every state tensor before raw_load_state_dict and before emitting state_dict.

blockers.finding: An initialized rank with zero locally materialized state is rejected because initialized requires a nonempty state_manifest. This is a legitimate world-size/rank-sparse outcome when the rank owns no updated group and update_adamw is false.
blockers.required_correction: Allow an explicitly initialized empty manifest while retaining the phase/counter and exact empty-state bindings; pristine must remain distinct.

blockers.finding: The deliberate map-location design validates device only after raw_load_state_dict. If that post-load check fails, the live optimizer state remains mutated. A raw-loader exception after partial mutation likewise has no rollback.
blockers.required_correction: Snapshot or transactionally stage optimizer state and param-group values, then restore them on any raw-load or post-load validation failure. Counters, scalar cache, parameters and collectives must remain unchanged on rejection.
